automated.title: immutable quote ownership scopes state, search, reports, history, PDF, preview and all write paths
configurable permissions are enforced and changes revoke sessions; managers cannot elevate administrator access
catalog and pricing managers can read their catalogs and update only their permitted product fields
independent approval, draft-only editing and deletion permission are enforced by the backend
WhatsApp manual sharing stores a protected immutable PDF and truthful separate history, failure and retry
saving a WhatsApp recipient is atomic with preparation and enforces version and edit permission
WhatsApp settings reject unconfigured providers and secrets and templates are resolved only on server
a sharing-only employee uses saved contact data and needs customer edit permission to override the recipient
additive schema upgrade resolves only unambiguous legacy owners and preserves unknown historical ownership
initial setup is single-use, uses secure session attributes, and protects private data
bad credentials fail and logout invalidates a copied session cookie
authenticated writes require CSRF and reject a foreign Origin without changing state
simultaneous writes reject stale revisions and cannot overwrite the winning change
new quotes receive server prices, identity, numbering, and status history
saved item snapshots resist tampering and catalog changes until explicit refresh
invalid state is rejected atomically for negative, non-finite, invalid IDs and missing references
employee role can save customers but cannot administer users, catalog, settings or approvals
password changes verify the current password and reject the old password
PostgreSQL preserves saved quotations, revisions and credentials across application restart
dedicated customer CRUD supports duplicate review, versions, search, paging, and dependencies
catalog/category APIs validate pricing, dependencies, inactive choices, and admin access
quotation CRUD, preview, status, copy, repricing and historical document snapshots are authoritative
record versions permit unrelated concurrent edits and reject lost updates on the same record
atomic change API rolls back all operations and keeps a durable audit trail
reports use persisted prices, apply date/customer filters, and produce escaped CSV
employee restrictions cover resources, approval, audits, backups, settings and exports
team lifecycle protects the last administrator, revokes sessions and requires temporary-password replacement
users can inspect and revoke only their own sessions
PostgreSQL backups restore to a new database, preserve records, revoke sessions, and refuse overwrite

expiry action is selective and does not add repeated status history
login throttling persists across a separately started server connection
audit history outlives the recent-activity window and rejects forged client events
request limits, private files, unknown routes and header-based deletion fail safely
